{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_data = data[data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check the size of the loyal group
print("Number of loyal customers:", len(loyal_data))

# Check converted values in loyal group
converted_loyal = loyal_data['converted'].value_counts().sort_index()
print("Converted counts in loyal group:", converted_loyal)

# Compute fraction converted
fraction_converted = converted_loyal.get(1, 0) / len(loyal_data)
print("Fraction converted among loyal customers:", fraction_converted)

# Confirm no missing values in converted or customer_segment
print("Missing in customer_segment:", loyal_data['customer_segment'].isnull().sum())
print("Missing in converted:", loyal_data['converted'].isnull().sum())"}
